comment: Source read at commit f427150, settled the same way as RackNES. NO FAMILY IS GIVEN TO THESE JACKS. What each one expects depends on which memory location its selector is set to: 85 of the 108 mapped locations take a 0-10V level and the other 23 are marked as toggles and take a trigger (GameMaps.hpp, and CVGenie.cpp:87 branches on isToggle). One colour would be wrong for whichever set of locations it did not match. OUT-OF-BOUNDS READ WITH NOTHING SELECTED: GameMap starts with gameId -1 and every memLoc at -1 (CVGenie.cpp:48, GameMaps.hpp:194), and process at line 87 calls isToggle as soon as a cable is in, with no check that a game and a location have been chosen. GameMaps.hpp:207-227 then index games[-1][-1], which is outside the table. The source also carries an OutputGenie model, but the installed plugin.json registers only RackNES and InputGenie, and the output half of process is commented out. The eight selectors and the game chooser are LedDisplay widgets rather than parameters, so the census records no paramPos for them and no click can reach them for help; they are covered by Note lines instead. The maker named none of the eight inputs, so Rack shows no tooltip on them.
